paragraphs.text: Benjamin Franklin was born in Boston, Massachusetts, in 1706. He grew up in a large family with sixteen brothers and sisters. Though he only went to school for two years, he loved to read about many different things.

pieces.text: When Benjamin Franklin was twelve, he began working in a print shop owned by his older brother. A
makes things like books and newspapers. Together, the Franklin brothers printed a newspaper.

But when he was seventeen, Franklin got into a fight with his brother. He ran away to the city of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. There, Franklin started his own print shop. He also made his own newspaper and a book called
. This book predicted the weather. It also had lots of advice like "Time is money." This means that people should not waste time.

paragraphs.text: Franklin did many things to help Philadelphia. He created the city's first fire department. He opened the city's first library and started a school. Franklin was also in charge of Philadelphia's mail. He helped people send letters.

pieces.text: Franklin never stopped learning. He used things he learned to make inventions.

are new things that people can use. He invented a new kind of glasses that helped people see both nearby and far away. He also figured out that lightning is made of electricity. He used this information to invent the lightning rod. A
is a metal stick on a roof. The lightning hits the metal rod instead of hitting the house. Benjamin Franklin's inventions helped many people.

pieces.text: George Washington was born in Virginia in 1732. He had a large family with nine brothers and sisters. They lived in a big house with a lot of farmland. George Washington's family was

, meaning that they had a lot of money. Most children during this time did not go to school because they had to work and help their families. Washington was able to go to school because his father could pay for it. He even had
, meaning teachers who came to his home.

paragraphs.text: When George Washington was eleven years old, his father died. His family had less money, and Washington could no longer go to school or have tutors. He didn't learn how to do things many other wealthy people could do, like play piano or speak French. Even though he could not go to school, he still wanted to learn. So, Washington read a lot of books. He was worried about not having good manners, so he read books about how to behave the correct way. He came up with 110 rules about good manners that he followed for his whole life.

George Washington did more than read books. He was a hard worker and a good leader. When he got older, he became a leader in the army. Later, he even became the first president of the United States of America.

pieces.text: Paul Revere was born in Boston in 1735. As a young man, he became a silversmith. A
is someone who makes things out of silver, like teapots, spoons, and rings. Revere was one of the best silversmiths in Boston.

paragraphs.text: At that time, Boston was part of the Thirteen Colonies. The Thirteen Colonies belonged to a country called Great Britain. Many people did not like that Great Britain had control of the colonies.

Great Britain sent soldiers to Boston to make people follow their rules. Paul Revere and many other people did not like having the British soldiers in Boston. Sometimes there were fights between the soldiers and the people in Boston. One evening, another fight started. Some people say the townspeople started the fight by yelling and throwing things at soldiers. Other people disagree. No matter how it began, the fight ended with British soldiers killing five people.

Revere was angry that British soldiers had killed people in his town. He wanted other people to know about it. So, he made a picture of the event that showed British soldiers hurting people. Many people saw copies of this picture and got angry at Great Britain.

Sometimes there were fights between the soldiers and the people in Boston. One evening, another fight started. Some people say the townspeople started the fight by yelling and throwing things at soldiers. Other people disagree. No matter how it began, the fight ended with British soldiers killing five people.

Revere was angry that British soldiers had killed people in his town. He wanted other people to know about it. So, he made a picture of the event that showed British soldiers hurting people. Many people saw copies of this picture and got angry at Great Britain.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Jefferson was an important writer and leader who helped the United States become a country. He was born in Virginia in 1743. At that time, the United States was not its own country. Instead, it was called the Thirteen Colonies. It was controlled by Great Britain. Americans had to follow British laws.

pieces.text: Many people in the Thirteen Colonies wanted independence.
means that a country is free and makes its own laws. Thomas Jefferson helped write the
. It told Great Britain that the colonies were now their own country, the United States of America.
Jefferson wrote about many important ideas in the Declaration of Independence. He wrote that all men are equal. Being
means that everyone should be treated the same way. Today, people in the United States believe all people are equal, not just men.
Jefferson also wrote that people should have freedom.
means everyone can make their own choices about how to live their lives. Jefferson believed that people should be free to do what they want to do.

paragraphs.text: People admired Thomas Jefferson for the ideas he wrote in the Declaration of Independence. So, they listened to his ideas about government. Jefferson believed that if the government was too powerful, everyone would be less free. So, he believed that the government should serve the people and do what the people ask.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Jefferson was an important writer and leader who helped the United States become a country. He was born in Virginia in 1743. At that time, the United States was not its own country. Instead, it was called the Thirteen Colonies. It was controlled by Great Britain. Americans had to follow British laws.

pieces.text: Many people in the Thirteen Colonies wanted independence.
means that a country is free and makes its own laws. Thomas Jefferson helped write the
. It told Great Britain that the colonies were now their own country, the United States of America.
Jefferson wrote about many important ideas in the Declaration of Independence. He wrote that all men are equal. Being
means that everyone should be treated the same way. Today, people in the United States believe all people are equal, not just men.
Jefferson also wrote that people should have freedom.
means everyone can make their own choices about how to live their lives. Jefferson believed that people should be free to do what they want to do.

paragraphs.text: People admired Thomas Jefferson for the ideas he wrote in the Declaration of Independence. So, they listened to his ideas about government. Jefferson believed that if the government was too powerful, everyone would be less free. So, he believed that the government should serve the people and do what the people ask.

choices.text: It was Virginia, ruled by thirteen leaders.
It was the Thirteen Colonies, ruled by Great Britain.
It was Great Britain, ruled by Jefferson's family.

pieces.text: John Deere was born in Vermont in 1804. Back then, people did not have the machines that we have now, like computers and phones. But they did have tools made of a strong metal called iron. When John was a young man, he decided to become a blacksmith. A
uses metal to make tools like hammers, nails, and shovels.

paragraphs.text: At that time, the United States was much smaller than it is today. Most Americans lived in the eastern part of the country. But it was difficult for John Deere to find work in the East, because so many blacksmiths already lived there. So, like many other people at the time, Deere moved farther west, to Illinois.

Many people moving west were farmers. But farming in the West was harder than farming in the East. The ground in Illinois had a lot of clay in it, which made the dirt sticky. This clay made it difficult to break up dirt in the ground to plant seeds and grow food.

pieces.text: Many farmers use a tool called a plow to help them break up the ground and grow plants. A

has metal blades that push through the dirt. But since the western dirt and clay would stick to the plows' iron blades, farmers needed to clean the blades every few steps. Sometimes, sticky dirt would even break the plows. So, when Deere moved to Illinois, he spent a lot of time fixing broken plows.

Many people moving west were farmers. But farming in the West was harder than farming in the East. The ground in Illinois had a lot of clay in it, which made the dirt sticky. This clay made it difficult to break up dirt in the ground to plant seeds and grow food.

pieces.text: Many farmers use a tool called a plow to help them break up the ground and grow plants. A

has metal blades that push through the dirt. But since the western dirt and clay would stick to the plows' iron blades, farmers needed to clean the blades every few steps. Sometimes, sticky dirt would even break the plows. So, when Deere moved to Illinois, he spent a lot of time fixing broken plows.

content.text: A photo of Abraham Lincoln before he became president

paragraphs.text: Abraham Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family was poor. They lived in a log house with only one room. Lincoln's parents could not read or write. In 1816, his family moved to Indiana. Life was not easy. When Lincoln was only nine years old, his mother got sick and died.

In Indiana, Lincoln worked hard on the family's farm. As a child, Lincoln pushed the plow and planted seeds in the fields. He even cut logs with an ax. Working on the farm kept Lincoln very busy. He did not have much time to go to school. Still, he loved to read. He carried a book in his pocket while he worked. Sometimes, he walked a long way to borrow books from his neighbors.

pieces.text: As Lincoln grew, he learned many things through books. He learned about the law so he could help people. As a young man, he moved to Illinois and became a lawyer. A

is someone who can help people when they disagree about the law. Lincoln was known for working hard and telling the truth. So, people began to call him "Honest Abe." Later, Lincoln helped make laws in government. Finally, in 1861, he became the 16th president of the United States.

paragraphs.text: Abraham Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family was poor. They lived in a log house with only one room. Lincoln's parents could not read or write. In 1816, his family moved to Indiana. Life was not easy. When Lincoln was only nine years old, his mother got sick and died.

In Indiana, Lincoln worked hard on the family's farm. As a child, Lincoln pushed the plow and planted seeds in the fields. He even cut logs with an ax. Working on the farm kept Lincoln very busy. He did not have much time to go to school. Still, he loved to read. He carried a book in his pocket while he worked. Sometimes, he walked a long way to borrow books from his neighbors.

paragraphs.text: Abraham Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family was poor. They lived in a log house with only one room. Lincoln's parents could not read or write. In 1816, his family moved to Indiana. Life was not easy. When Lincoln was only nine years old, his mother got sick and died.

In Indiana, Lincoln worked hard on the family's farm. As a child, Lincoln pushed the plow and planted seeds in the fields. He even cut logs with an ax. Working on the farm kept Lincoln very busy. He did not have much time to go to school. Still, he loved to read. He carried a book in his pocket while he worked. Sometimes, he walked a long way to borrow books from his neighbors.

pieces.text: As Lincoln grew, he learned many things through books. He learned about the law so he could help people. As a young man, he moved to Illinois and became a lawyer. A

is someone who can help people when they disagree about the law. Lincoln was known for working hard and telling the truth. So, people began to call him "Honest Abe." Later, Lincoln helped make laws in government. Finally, in 1861, he became the 16th president of the United States.

content.text: Frederick Douglass as a young man, after he escaped slavery

pieces.text: Frederick Douglass was born in Maryland around 1818. Back then, the United States allowed slavery.

means a person is owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Many Black people were enslaved. Enslaved people were not free to do what they wanted. They had to work long hours and did not get paid any money. They could even be sold and taken away from their families. But Frederick Douglass worked hard to change all that.

paragraphs.text: Frederick Douglass was enslaved as a child. He was forced to work like an adult when he was young. He had to do many jobs on a farm, like cleaning and working in the fields. Douglass was often cold and hungry. He did not have enough food to eat or warm clothing to wear.

Frederick Douglass's life was very hard, but he loved to learn. He wanted to learn how to read and write. Enslaved people like Douglass were not allowed to go to school or learn to read and write. But Douglass found ways to learn anyway. Even though he had very little food, he gave some of it to white children so they would teach him. He also secretly practiced with an old book.

Once Frederick Douglass learned to read and write, he read books and newspapers to learn about freedom and slavery. He believed that reading could help people be free! So, he secretly taught other enslaved people to read, too.

pieces.text: Harriet Tubman was born in the United States in 1822. When Tubman was young, the United States allowed slavery.

means a person is owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Enslaved people had to do hard work without being paid. They were not free to go where they wanted. Enslaved people could be hurt if they didn't do what they were told. Many Black people were enslaved in the United States.

paragraphs.text: Tubman grew up on a large farm in the South. When she was a child, she had to work all day long. She cooked and cleaned the house for the people who enslaved her. She also had to do hard work outside. She farmed in fields and carried heavy logs.

Enslaved people were often sold and taken away from their families. Tubman had many brothers and sisters. When she was young, three of her sisters were sold and taken far away. Tubman did not know if she would ever see them again. She did not want her family to be enslaved.

pieces.text: So, when Harriet Tubman was twenty-seven years old, she decided to escape from slavery. To

means to run away from the people who enslaved her. Not all states in the U.S. allowed slavery. States in the South did, but most states in the North did not. So, Tubman went north alone. She escaped by walking at night, following a bright star called the North Star. It helped her find her way to freedom in the North.

She escaped by walking at night, following a bright star called the North Star. It helped her find her way to freedom in the North.

contents.text: When Harriet Tubman escaped from slavery, why did she go to the North?

choices.text: If she made it to the North, she would be free.
If she went to the North, she could go to school.
She wanted to find a job in one of the big northern cities.
She had family in the North who wanted her to live with them.

pieces.text: Harriet Tubman was born in the United States in 1822. When Tubman was young, the United States allowed slavery.

means a person is owned by someone else and forced to work for them. Enslaved people had to do hard work without being paid. They were not free to go where they wanted. Enslaved people could be hurt if they didn't do what they were told. Many Black people were enslaved in the United States.

paragraphs.text: Tubman grew up on a large farm in the South. When she was a child, she had to work all day long. She cooked and cleaned the house for the people who enslaved her. She also had to do hard work outside. She farmed in fields and carried heavy logs.

Enslaved people were often sold and taken away from their families. Tubman had many brothers and sisters. When she was young, three of her sisters were sold and taken far away. Tubman did not know if she would ever see them again. She did not want her family to be enslaved.

paragraphs.text: Tubman grew up on a large farm in the South. When she was a child, she had to work all day long. She cooked and cleaned the house for the people who enslaved her. She also had to do hard work outside. She farmed in fields and carried heavy logs.

Enslaved people were often sold and taken away from their families. Tubman had many brothers and sisters. When she was young, three of her sisters were sold and taken far away. Tubman did not know if she would ever see them again. She did not want her family to be enslaved.

pieces.text: So, when Harriet Tubman was twenty-seven years old, she decided to escape from slavery. To

means to run away from the people who enslaved her. Not all states in the U.S. allowed slavery. States in the South did, but most states in the North did not. So, Tubman went north alone. She escaped by walking at night, following a bright star called the North Star. It helped her find her way to freedom in the North.

contents.text: When Harriet Tubman escaped from slavery, why did she go to the North?

choices.text: If she went to the North, she could go to school.
If she made it to the North, she would be free.
She had family in the North who wanted her to live with them.
She wanted to find a job in one of the big northern cities.

content.text: The passage says that not all states in the U.S. allowed slavery. States in the South did, but most states in the North did not. So, if Harriet Tubman made it to the North, she would be free.

content.text: Susan B. Anthony when she was 28 years old

paragraphs.text: Susan B. Anthony was born in 1820. When she was growing up, women were not treated the same as men. Women were not allowed to do things that men could do. Susan B. Anthony worked hard to change that.

pieces.text: When Susan was little, she loved to learn. She read lots of books and worked hard in school. But as she grew up, Susan noticed that many other girls did not go to school. They had to stay home to help around the house. Susan thought this was wrong. Her family believed that men and women were equal.
means that people are the same and they deserve to be treated the same way.

paragraphs.text: After Susan B. Anthony grew up, she worked as a teacher. At that time, female teachers were not paid equally. Male teachers made about $10 a month, but female teachers only made $2. Women were paid much less for doing the same work! This bothered Susan B. Anthony. She wanted women to be treated fairly.

pieces.text: Back then, only men could vote. When you

, you help choose the leaders in the government. Susan B. Anthony believed it was important for women to get to vote. She wanted leaders who would treat women fairly. After teaching for many years, she became a suffragist.
were people who fought for women to be allowed to vote.

pieces.text: Like other Lakota, Sitting Bull grew up traveling across the open grassland. The Lakota rode horses from place to place. They traveled to hunt bison.

. Tipis were made of logs and animal skin. Tipis were quick to set up and take down.

are big animals with horns and four legs. The Lakota lived in cone-shaped tents called
. Tipis were made of logs and animal skin. Tipis were quick to set up and take down.

pieces.text: Thomas Edison was born in 1847. Back then, life was very different. There were no TVs, phones, or computers. Edison was a very curious child. When he was young, he turned his family's basement into his laboratory. A

is a place where people make and test things. Even though Edison loved to learn, he did not do well in school. So, his mother taught him at home. He read books to learn. His favorite books were about science.

paragraphs.text: When Edison was around the age of twelve, he got very sick and had a high fever. After that, he could not hear very well. Edison believed that his difficulty hearing helped him pay close attention to his work.

pieces.text: Edison loved figuring out new ways to do things. When he grew up, he became an inventor. An
is a person who thinks of new ideas and makes things that nobody made before. The new things they make are called
. Inventions fix problems and make life easier for people.
One of Edison's inventions was called the phonograph. A
records and plays back sounds so people can listen to something again and again. People used it to listen to music.

paragraphs.text: Not all of Thomas Edison's inventions were successes. He invented a machine to count votes. But people did not want to use it. When Edison's ideas didn't work, he tried even harder. He said, "I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work."

pieces.text: Thomas Edison was born in 1847. Back then, life was very different. There were no TVs, phones, or computers. Edison was a very curious child. When he was young, he turned his family's basement into his laboratory. A

is a place where people make and test things. Even though Edison loved to learn, he did not do well in school. So, his mother taught him at home. He read books to learn. His favorite books were about science.

paragraphs.text: When Edison was around the age of twelve, he got very sick and had a high fever. After that, he could not hear very well. Edison believed that his difficulty hearing helped him pay close attention to his work.

pieces.text: Edison loved figuring out new ways to do things. When he grew up, he became an inventor. An
is a person who thinks of new ideas and makes things that nobody made before. The new things they make are called
. Inventions fix problems and make life easier for people.
One of Edison's inventions was called the phonograph. A
records and plays back sounds so people can listen to something again and again. People used it to listen to music.

paragraphs.text: Not all of Thomas Edison's inventions were successes. He invented a machine to count votes. But people did not want to use it. When Edison's ideas didn't work, he tried even harder. He said, "I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work."

contents.text: Which of the following are examples of inventions? Pick two.

choices.text: an elevator
a phone
a tree
a river

contents.text: The passage says that the new things inventors make are called inventions. Inventions fix problems and make life easier for people. So, an elevator is an invention because it helps people go to different floors in a building. A phone is also an invention because it helps people talk to other people who are far away.
The other choices are not correct. A tree and a river are not inventions because people did not make them.

paragraphs.text: Theodore Roosevelt was born in New York in 1858. As a child, he was often sick. To get healthier, Roosevelt spent a lot of time playing sports and exercising. Since he was too sick to go to school, his teachers came to his house. Roosevelt loved to read about history and the outdoors.

pieces.text: When he was older, Theodore Roosevelt lived in North Dakota for several years. In North Dakota, he raised cattle and hunted a large animal called bison. He loved living close to nature.
means animals, plants, and other things in the world that are not made by people. Roosevelt wrote books about the beauty of nature in North Dakota.

paragraphs.text: In 1898, the United States went to war with Spain. Roosevelt led a group in the U.S. Army called the Rough Riders. Many people read about the fights Roosevelt and the Rough Riders were in. People celebrated Roosevelt as a hero.

After the war, Roosevelt became a governor in New York state. Later, Roosevelt became vice president of the United States. In 1901, the president died, and Roosevelt became president. He was the youngest person ever to become president of the United States!

pieces.text: George Washington Carver was born in Missouri in the 1860s. Back then, many places were segregated.
means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people were not allowed to use the same parks, libraries, or schools as white people.

paragraphs.text: As a child, George Washington Carver loved to learn and wanted to go to school. But schools in his town did not allow Black children. So Carver found ways to learn at home. He liked studying the plants and flowers in the woods near his farm. Carver also helped his neighbors, who were mostly poor farmers, care for their gardens. He was so good at gardening that people called him "the plant doctor." When Carver was around 11, he went to a school for Black children. It was far from his home, so Carver had to move away to go to that school.

When George Washington Carver got older, he wanted to keep learning about plants. The first college he tried to go to did not let him in because he was Black. A few years later, Carver became the first Black student at Iowa State College. He studied farming. Then he got a job teaching farming at a college for Black students. Carver taught for 47 years. He wanted to be a teacher to help poor farmers like the ones he grew up around.

pieces.text: George Washington Carver was born in Missouri in the 1860s. Back then, many places were segregated.
means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people were not allowed to use the same parks, libraries, or schools as white people.

paragraphs.text: As a child, George Washington Carver loved to learn and wanted to go to school. But schools in his town did not allow Black children. So Carver found ways to learn at home. He liked studying the plants and flowers in the woods near his farm. Carver also helped his neighbors, who were mostly poor farmers, care for their gardens. He was so good at gardening that people called him "the plant doctor." When Carver was around 11, he went to a school for Black children. It was far from his home, so Carver had to move away to go to that school.

When George Washington Carver got older, he wanted to keep learning about plants. The first college he tried to go to did not let him in because he was Black. A few years later, Carver became the first Black student at Iowa State College. He studied farming. Then he got a job teaching farming at a college for Black students. Carver taught for 47 years. He wanted to be a teacher to help poor farmers like the ones he grew up around.

paragraphs.text: Amelia Earhart was born in 1897. The first airplanes were built when she was a child. Back then, airplanes were not as safe as they are today. Planes were not built well. They would sometimes break or crash. It was also easy for pilots to get lost. So, pilots had to fly close to the ground so they could see where they were going. Every flight was dangerous!
Even though they were dangerous, planes were exciting. When Earhart was 23 years old, she rode in a plane for the first time. She loved it! She decided to become a pilot right away.

Earhart was a brave and skilled pilot. Two years after her first ride in an airplane, she set her first flying record. She flew higher in the sky than any woman had flown before. But she wanted to do something even bigger!

Earhart decided to fly across the Atlantic Ocean by herself. She flew for 15 hours. At the end of her flight, her plane leaked gas, and a fire started! She had to land quickly to put out the fire. But her flight was a success. She was the first woman to fly a plane across the Atlantic Ocean alone.

At the time, most pilots were men. Many people did not think women could be pilots. But Amelia Earhart's long and dangerous flight across the Atlantic Ocean showed that women could be pilots, too. Her record-setting flight made her famous. She earned awards for her bravery and flying skills.

paragraphs.text: Amelia Earhart was born in 1897. The first airplanes were built when she was a child. Back then, airplanes were not as safe as they are today. Planes were not built well. They would sometimes break or crash. It was also easy for pilots to get lost. So, pilots had to fly close to the ground so they could see where they were going. Every flight was dangerous!
Even though they were dangerous, planes were exciting. When Earhart was 23 years old, she rode in a plane for the first time. She loved it! She decided to become a pilot right away.

Earhart was a brave and skilled pilot. Two years after her first ride in an airplane, she set her first flying record. She flew higher in the sky than any woman had flown before. But she wanted to do something even bigger!

Earhart decided to fly across the Atlantic Ocean by herself. She flew for 15 hours. At the end of her flight, her plane leaked gas, and a fire started! She had to land quickly to put out the fire. But her flight was a success. She was the first woman to fly a plane across the Atlantic Ocean alone.

At the time, most pilots were men. Many people did not think women could be pilots. But Amelia Earhart's long and dangerous flight across the Atlantic Ocean showed that women could be pilots, too. Her record-setting flight made her famous. She earned awards for her bravery and flying skills.

content.text: Marshall as a lawyer for the NAACP

pieces.text: Thurgood Marshall was born in Maryland in 1908. At this time, many places were segregated.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people and treated unfairly. The schools for Black children were in older, smaller buildings with fewer books. Thurgood and other Black students knew they were not getting the same chances to learn as white students.
Thurgood's father wanted him to have chances to learn outside of school. So, Thurgood and his father went to court to listen to lawyers argue. A

understands the law and can use it to help people. Thurgood liked to listen to the lawyers. He decided to go to law school. But most law schools would not teach Black students. So, Thurgood Marshall went to Howard University, which had a good law school for Black students. Law school cost so much money that Marshall's mother had to sell her wedding ring to help pay for it.

paragraphs.text: After Marshall became a lawyer, he worked for a group called the NAACP. Marshall and the NAACP argued for Black people in court if they were being treated unfairly. Marshall helped people who weren't allowed to vote or were kicked out of their homes just because of their skin color. He even helped people who didn't have money to pay for a lawyer.

contents.text: What did it mean if a school was segregated?

choices.text: The school was either only for white children or only for Black children.
Children lived at the school and only came home on weekends.
Students went to school outside and learned skills like growing plants in a garden.
Students with different skin colors all learned together in the same school.

pieces.text: Rosa Parks was a Black woman born in Alabama in 1913. During this time, Alabama was

by race. Segregated means that Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people were not allowed to use the same schools, churches, or libraries as white people. paragraphs.text: Segregation was part of Rosa Parks's life. When she was a child, she had to go to a school just for Black children. The schools for white children had a bus, but the schools for Black children did not. The schools for white children were in nice buildings. Her school was old and crowded. This made it hard for students to get the help that they needed.

pieces.text: Jackie Robinson was born in Georgia in 1919. When he was born, many places in the United States were segregated.
means that Black people were kept apart from white people. They could not go to the same schools, eat at the same places, or use the same bathrooms.
Growing up, Robinson was a great athlete. An

is someone who plays sports. Robinson was the first athlete at his college to win awards in four sports. He won awards in track, basketball, football, and baseball. After Robinson finished college, the United States entered World War II. Robinson became a soldier. At that time, even the army was segregated. One day, Robinson got in trouble for sitting next to a white person on an army bus. The driver told him to move. But Robinson knew that was not fair. He stayed where he was.

paragraphs.text: After World War II, Robinson became a baseball player. At that time, baseball teams were segregated. The most famous baseball teams were part of the Major League. But only white players could join Major League Baseball teams. Black players had to play on their own teams. These teams were not as famous. Black players also did not make as much money as white players.

One Major League Baseball team was called the Dodgers. The Dodgers had a boss who thought segregation was wrong. He knew that Jackie Robinson played for an all-Black team called the Kansas City Monarchs. The boss asked Robinson to come play for the Dodgers and help end segregation in baseball. Jackie Robinson agreed. He became the first Black person to play for a modern Major League Baseball team.

means that Black people were kept apart from white people. They could not go to the same schools, eat at the same places, or use the same bathrooms.
Growing up, Robinson was a great athlete. An

is someone who plays sports. Robinson was the first athlete at his college to win awards in four sports. He won awards in track, basketball, football, and baseball. After Robinson finished college, the United States entered World War II. Robinson became a soldier. At that time, even the army was segregated. One day, Robinson got in trouble for sitting next to a white person on an army bus. The driver told him to move. But Robinson knew that was not fair. He stayed where he was.

paragraphs.text: After World War II, Robinson became a baseball player. At that time, baseball teams were segregated. The most famous baseball teams were part of the Major League. But only white players could join Major League Baseball teams. Black players had to play on their own teams. These teams were not as famous. Black players also did not make as much money as white players.

One Major League Baseball team was called the Dodgers. The Dodgers had a boss who thought segregation was wrong. He knew that Jackie Robinson played for an all-Black team called the Kansas City Monarchs. The boss asked Robinson to come play for the Dodgers and help end segregation in baseball. Jackie Robinson agreed. He became the first Black person to play for a modern Major League Baseball team.

Black players were paid less than white players.
Black teams made more money than white teams.

means Black people were kept apart from white people. Black people couldn't go to the same schools, parks, and restaurants as white people.

paragraphs.text: As a child, Martin Luther King Jr. spent a lot of time in church with his family. His father was a church leader. Martin Luther King Jr. enjoyed singing in church, playing sports, and reading. He read many books about famous Black leaders who helped to change the world. In high school, he became known as a great speaker. He won several speaking contests.

pieces.text: When he grew up, Dr. King became a church leader like his father. He started speaking out against segregation. Later, Dr. King joined the civil rights movement. The
was a group that wanted to end segregation.
Dr. King led many protests.

are when people come together to show they want something to change. Protesters were angry that Black people were treated so badly. Some people wanted to fight back. But Dr. King said protesters should be peaceful no matter what. He wanted to make a change without hurting people.

contents.text: Listen and read along with the passage about Neil Armstrong.

paragraphs.text: Neil Armstrong was born in 1930. When he was six, he rode in an airplane for the first time. He loved it! He wanted to become a pilot. Armstrong learned to fly a plane before he could even drive a car! In college, he learned how to build airplanes.

When Armstrong was nineteen years old, the United States went to war. Armstrong helped by flying planes in the war. When the war ended, he returned to school to continue learning about planes. Afterward, he worked as a test pilot. He flew many new planes to make sure they were safe. He became a skilled pilot.

pieces.text: Around the same time, people started to think about going to space.

is everything outside Earth, where the Moon and stars are. No one had ever gone to space before. The United States and another country called the Soviet Union raced to be the first to go into space. This race to explore space was called the

paragraphs.text: Both countries worked hard to send the first people to space. People made powerful spaceships that could fly above Earth and into space. These spaceships had to be very strong and very fast. But this made them dangerous. Some spaceships even caught on fire!

pieces.text: In April of 1961, the Soviet Union sent the first person to space. The United States had to catch up! The United States needed people to test the spaceships. But no one knew how to fly spaceships yet, since they were brand new! Neil Armstrong was a great pilot, and he was not afraid to try new things. So, the United States asked Neil Armstrong and some other airplane pilots to try flying spaceships. He became one of the world's first astronauts. An
is a person who goes into space. Neil Armstrong was ready to fly higher than ever before!

contents.text: Neil Armstrong wanted to be a pilot when he grew up. What is a pilot?

choices.text: someone who takes care of animals
someone who builds houses
someone who races cars
someone who flies airplanes

paragraphs.text: Neil Armstrong was born in 1930. When he was six, he rode in an airplane for the first time. He loved it! He wanted to become a pilot. Armstrong learned to fly a plane before he could even drive a car! In college, he learned how to build airplanes.

contents.text: Listen and read along with the passage about Bill Gates.

paragraphs.text: Bill Gates was born in 1955 and grew up in Seattle, Washington. Gates was a curious child who liked to read books, learn math, and play sports. When he was 13 years old, he became interested in computers.

During Bill Gates's childhood, computers were very different. Computers did not have the internet or games like today. They were really big and could take up entire rooms. Those computers were too expensive for most people to buy. People did not have computers in their homes. Most schools did not have computers, but Gates's school did.

pieces.text: Bill Gates spent a lot of time on the computer learning about what it could do. He learned about
, meaning the parts of a computer that can be touched, like the screen and keyboard. He also learned about
, which means the directions that tell a computer what to do.

paragraphs.text: Bill Gates worked hard learning how to write software. He learned how to make computers do different tasks. One of his first projects was writing software so he could play tic-tac-toe on the computer. Gates wanted to make computers better. He started making software to help people use computers at home, school, and work. For example, when he was in high school, he wrote software for his school to make lists that decided which students were in each class.

He learned about hardware, meaning the parts of a computer that can be touched, like the screen and keyboard. He also learned about software, which means the directions that tell a computer what to do.

contents.text: Listen and read along with the passage about Bill Gates.

paragraphs.text: Bill Gates was born in 1955 and grew up in Seattle, Washington. Gates was a curious child who liked to read books, learn math, and play sports. When he was 13 years old, he became interested in computers.

During Bill Gates's childhood, computers were very different. Computers did not have the internet or games like today. They were really big and could take up entire rooms. Those computers were too expensive for most people to buy. People did not have computers in their homes. Most schools did not have computers, but Gates's school did.

paragraphs.text: Bill Gates worked hard learning how to write software. He learned how to make computers do different tasks. One of his first projects was writing software so he could play tic-tac-toe on the computer. Gates wanted to make computers better. He started making software to help people use computers at home, school, and work. For example, when he was in high school, he wrote software for his school to make lists that decided which students were in each class.

contents.text: Why did Bill Gates learn to write software?

choices.text: He thought software would help him write better stories.
He wanted people to use computers to do many things.
He wanted to make computers more expensive and harder to use.
He planned to play computer games instead of going to school.
